full_page.content:
1935, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 75 Cont.
Dec. 5 Mrs. Cath. Van Pouker - 65 - fell on steps after confession two weeks ago and broke leg - now in cast - hoping.
Page 76
Dec. 10 Norma Bell - 21 - just weak & somewhat nerveous. Mrs. Cath. Yount - 33 - confinement expected. .
Sam LaRocca - 12 - 6 Father not to Easter ..... big boy physically but mind of a 6 yr. old .....
Mrs. C. W. Hammers - trying to sell Valuable property - finds it hard to keep up taxes ...
10 Mrs. Teresa Scheuer - 68 - Verecose ulcers, fearful pains. . . 7 weeks ago blood-pressure 270 was enrolled at that time - normal now.
11 James McCarthy - 16 - very critical- blood transfusion yesterday - mother had stroke last Tuesday.
Harry Breen - 42 - operation last Saturday. .... Helen Coucguyct - 4 - Infantile & whooping.
Page 77 Dec. 16 Eliz. Boismir - about 50 - raising three orphans - nieces & nephew. hopeless cancer six weeks ago - now O.K. Deo Grat.
Martin Edwards - 23 - non Cath. - working for Bejin Trucking Co. - rolled off road and over bank with ten tons of iron .... saturated with gasoline and pinned in cab (of truck) half burried in dirt - roof under - he was dug out by farmer and walked away without scratch or hurt, but with vivid picture in his mind of shining St. Christopher medal he'd been
Yvonne Rheault - 34 - Has husband & 2 small children, kidney & bl. trouble cancer feared.
Wm. J. LeMore - 13 Epileptic
16 Patricia McGuire of Chicago - 30 - now 4 years sleeping sickness - En- rolled To-day 50c
Bernard Podlasinski - 39 - has wife & son depending on him - has T.B. now 2 yrs.
